name: Irha Apparels Public Buyer Agent
description: A read-only B2B buyer agent for public Irha Apparels product discovery, factory-verification information and reviewable inquiry preparation. It does not submit buyer data or access owner-only systems.

skills.name: Browse B2B Collections
skills.description: Returns public Irha Apparels manufacturing programs and product collection links without making commercial commitments.
examples: Which product categories does Irha Apparels manufacture?
Show me the Bavarian and leather collections.

skills.name: Factory Verification
skills.description: Returns public buyer-trust and live factory video-call links. It does not book a meeting or claim an audit.
examples: How can I verify the factory?
Can I arrange a live factory video call?

skills.name: Prepare Buyer Inquiry
skills.description: Creates a reviewable website inquiry link. The buyer must review and submit the form; the agent never sends data automatically.
examples: Prepare an inquiry for 500 custom football kits.
I need a catalogue and sample information.
